title: App Store Top Charts Tracker Input

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes, e.g. us, gb, de, jp, br.

chartTypes.title: Chart types
chartTypes.description: Which charts to pull: top-free, top-paid, top-grossing.

categoryIds.title: Category IDs (optional)
categoryIds.description: Apple genre IDs to scope charts to a category, e.g. 6014 (Games), 6015 (Finance), 6005 (Social). Empty = overall charts.

topN.title: Chart depth
topN.description: How many ranks to return per chart (up to 200).

trackAppIds.title: Track only these app IDs (optional)
trackAppIds.description: Apple app IDs (the number in the store URL). When set, only these apps' rank rows are pushed; apps not found in a chart produce a free rank:null row.

compareWithPrevious.title: Compare with previous run
compareWithPrevious.description: Remember each chart between runs and add previousRank, rankChange, and isNew to every row. Built for scheduled runs.
